newsitem.title: UK: U.S. stocks in London down ahead of Europe holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks in London down ahead of Europe holiday.

text.p: U.S. shares were moderately lower in thin trade on Wednesday with many investors absent ahead of a European holiday on Thursday.
"The market is very quiet ahead of the holiday. Most European institutions will take Friday off as well," one market maker said.
Although London financial markets will open tomorrow, other major European bourses, including those in Germany, France, Switzerland, and the Netherlands will be shut in observance of Ascension Day.

Fluor Corp was down $4 to $52 after the engineering, construction and diversified services company said late Tuesday it expected to report a loss for the second quarter of about $70 million, or $0.83 a share.
Elsewhere, Intel Corp was up $1/4 to $158-1/4 after dropping $4-1/2 in New York on Tuesday after the company warned that there was a possible flaw with the company's Pentium chips.
The computer chip maker said it was looking into reports that its Pentium II and Pentium Pro chips could contain a bug that causes the chips to make computational errors in some rare cases.

Chrysler Corp was up $1/4 to $31-1/4 after the New York Times newspaper said the automaker had reached an agreement with the United Auto Workers union which would end a nearly month-long strike that has shut down production of some high-profit vehicles.
The June S&P 500 futures contract was down 0.95 to 833.90 while the June T-bond eased 6/32 to 109-30/32 by 1040 GMT.
